title: Sunflower Subscription Box - Unsusual Plugs - Starts in Apr/May - 1, 3, 6 Months - 6 Months
description:
Bring Sunshine to Your Garden All Summer Long!
 

 Get ready for a spectacular summer garden without the hassle of growing from seed! Our
 
  Sunflower Surprise Box
 
 delivers the joy of gardening straight to your door. Forget standard yellow—discover the stunning world of unusual and rare sunflower varieties with our monthly subscription service, starting just in time for the growing season this April/May.


 This is the perfect way to grow a show-stopping display with ease. Whether you are a beginner gardener or a seasoned pro looking for something different, these carefully selected varieties will amaze you.


 These also make wonderful gifts for your plant loving family member or friend!


  🌻 What’s Inside Your Monthly Box? 🌻
 

 Each month, you will receive a neatly packaged, eco-friendly box containing everything you need to get growing:


    Two (2x) Premium Sunflower Plug Plants:
   
   You will receive two healthy, strong seedlings grown in
   
    4cm biodegradable pots
   
   . These are ready to be potted on or planted out (weather permitting), giving you a huge head start over growing from seed.
  


    Unusual & Rare Varieties:
   
   We curate the stunning types you won't usually find in garden centres. Expect gorgeous reds, deep chocolates, vibrant bi-colours, and unique multi-headed branching types.
  


    Unusual Varieties E-Guide:
   
   A link to a handy booklet, providing specific care instructions and details about the unique blooms you are receiving that month.
  


    Eco-Friendly Packaging:
   
   Your plants arrive safely nestled in natural wood wool padding inside a recyclable cardboard box.
